steps.caption: IP Tracker
steps.narration: This is IP Tracker. It lists every visit your tracking code records on your website.

steps.caption: Pick the website
steps.narration: Pick the website. This roofing company tracks three, the same list Click Guard uses.

steps.caption: One tracking code
steps.narration: One script tag on the site feeds it. It's the same code as Click Guard, so one install covers both.

steps.caption: Online now, today, this week
steps.narration: The Dashboard counts who's online now, from the last twenty minutes, then today, yesterday, the last seven days and this month.

steps.caption: Fourteen days of visits
steps.narration: Below, Daily visits charts each of the last fourteen days.

steps.caption: Every visitor by IP
steps.narration: Visitors groups the visits by IP address, with the visit count, location, browser and when each was last seen.

steps.caption: Search by IP
steps.narration: Search by IP address to find one.

steps.caption: Browser, device, screen, time zone
steps.narration: Open a visitor to see the browser, system, device, screen size, language and time zone.

steps.caption: Where each visit came from
steps.narration: Recent activity lists each visit: the site that sent them, and the page they landed on.

steps.caption: Traffic sources
steps.narration: Traffic lists the websites that sent your visitors, by domain, with page loads and visitors for each.

steps.caption: Top pages
steps.narration: Pages shows the hits and unique visitors of each landing page.

steps.caption: Countries and cities
steps.narration: Geo counts visits by country and by city, when a location is available.

steps.caption: Browsers and devices
steps.narration: And Platforms breaks them down by browser, operating system, device and screen size.

steps.caption: Menu: IP Tracker
steps.narration: You'll find IP Tracker in the menu on the left, under Tools.

youtube.title: IP Tracker in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of IP Tracker in ConstructHUB: every visit your tracking code records, grouped by IP address, with each visitor's device, browser, landing pages and referrers, plus traffic sources, top pages, countries and cities, and platforms.
